title: Moving a group member by its own ElementId silently does nothing
task: Move an element that belongs to a placed group. ElementTransformUtils.MoveElement on the member's own ElementId has no effect at all; move the group instance instead.

pitfalls.symptom: ElementTransformUtils.MoveElement(doc, memberId, translation) returns normally with no warning, no error and no notice, and the element has not moved.
pitfalls.cause: A group member's own id is not a movable target while it is in the group; Revit ignores the call. Confirmed live and matching an independent report of the same behaviour for detail groups.
pitfalls.fix: Move the group instance's ElementId (a rigid-body move of the whole placed instance), or MoveElements with the group id plus its member ids. To move one member on its own, ungroup first.

provenance.ref: revit/test-harness/phase_a_test.go TestPhaseACoreCRUDAndQuery/EditGroupPropagatesToAllInstances (comment; the subtest deliberately does not exercise this path)
